name: EVEO
notes:
EVEO S.A. (AS53107) is a Brazilian data center, cloud and connectivity provider, operating data centers in São Paulo, Curitiba, Fortaleza and Miami.

NETWORK
- Multi-homed backbone with Tier-1 transit and direct interconnection with major Brazilian carriers.
- Present at IX.br São Paulo, Curitiba and Fortaleza, with direct reach to thousands of networks in Brazil.
- Redundant edge routers, diverse upstreams and multiple IX ports at our main sites. Native dual-stack IPv4/IPv6.

SERVICES
- IP Transit (IPv4/IPv6): BGP for customers with their own ASN and prefixes (full table or default route), or EVEO-provided address space.
- DDoS Protection: flow-based detection with automatic mitigation via BGP diversion to scrubbing, available to transit and colocation customers.
- Colocation, Private Cloud and Dedicated Servers.
Sales: https://www.eveo.com.br/
